name: study2_cohort_vhir
title: Emergency Department Visits with Diagnosis of Heart Failure
description: This cohort includes adult patients visiting the Emergency Department (whether or not the visit led to a hospital admission). The reference time point is the end of the Emergency Department visit. All patients in this cohort are assumed to have heart failure; therefore, no additional eligibility criteria are applied to confirm the presence of heart failure.

entry.name: patientEmergencyEncounter
entry.description: Captures visits/encounters to the Emergency Department, having the encounter class EMER.

eligibility.name: adults
eligibility.description: Exclude Patients who are younger than 18 years old at the time of the visit.
